Automatic imputation is limited to at most one-fifth missingness. Above this level, the observed sample may be too incomplete for a simple single-value fallback to be defensible without domain context.
At least five observed values are required before a single-value fallback is used. This is a conservative minimum for a small-sample engineering rule, not a statistical guarantee.
The conventional 1.5×IQR exploratory fence is used to flag unusual values. It identifies potential outliers; it does not establish that a value is erroneous.

The quality score is an internal comparison indicator. Errors receive full penalty, warnings 0.35 and informational findings 0.10 to preserve severity ordering. These weights are not learned and are not an industry standard.
